name: FA_WORK_ORDER_LINES
description: FA_WORK_ORDER_LINES contains work order line information for each work order. Each row represents a work order line storing job-wise information.

columns.name: ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Identifier of the work order line.

columns.name: ORDER_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Identifier of the work order.

columns.name: ORDER_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Work order line number.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job for the work order line.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the type of the work order line. Possible values are REPAIR, RECONSTRUCTION, MODERNIZATION.

columns.name: DISMANTLE_COST
columns.description: Cost of separating the machine into separate parts.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount payable according to the lease contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Repair, reconstruction and modernization charges as mentioned in the contract.

columns.name: FREIGHT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of freight for the work.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total of the freight charges, the asset adjustment amount, and the cost to dismantle the asset.

columns.name: ADDITION_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the work order line is added.

columns.name: TRANSFER_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the work order line is transferred.

columns.name: CHANGES_TO_ASSET
columns.description: Details of the maintenance work that was done.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Asset reviewer comments for the work order line.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CCID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier for the expense account.

columns.name: SOURCE_CCID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier for the source account.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
